messages:
marta: quick idea — what if the console surfaced async suggested filters for a route based on recent telemetry + per-model quality signals? want to sketch tradeoffs.

alex: sounds useful. are suggestions computed offline or on-demand?

marta: computed offline nightly + incrementally updated by streaming job. cheap to store, show in UI as non-blocking suggestions.

sam: curious how we determine signal strength. we can't surface noisy recs.

marta: agree — plan: combine three signals: 1) traffic skew (route-model mismatch), 2) latency outliers by model, 3) quality regressions from evals/prompt sets. score with heuristics + threshold.

jordan: +1. need to surface confidence and a sample example so PMs can validate. also perms — suggestions should be visible only to owners/admins?

marta: thinking: two toggles — public suggestions (org-wide) and owner-only drafts. default owner-only. show source badges: "telemetry", "latency", "eval".

alex: UX ask — can we let engineers preview filter impact (cost/latency delta) before applying? i.e., quick simulate token burn/avg latency based on sample window.

marta: totally. backend would call our sampling API. sketch of API:
```
GET /api/v1/routes/{route_id}/suggested-filters?since=24h&sample=true
returns: [ { filter: "model:small-quant", source: "latency", score: 0.82, sample_impact: { est_tokens: 12000, est_latency_ms: 14 } } ]
```

sam: careful: sample_impact must include confidence/CI. otherwise PMs will overtrust numbers.

marta: we can add +/- bounds and n_samples. also flag when sample size < X.

insights-bot: telemetry-job completed: generated 8 suggestions for route r-frontend in last run (run_id=20231112-8).

jordan: how do we handle quota implications? if a suggestion narrows model to a smaller cheaper model, good. but if it suggests shifting to larger models we need an approval flow.

marta: propose rule: any suggestion that increases expected cost by >10% goes to approval queue (owners + finance). UI shows a red cost delta badge.

alex: rollout UX: can be "apply to route preview" (ephemeral), "apply to route (canary)" (partial traffic), or "apply to route (immediate)". need telemetry-backed rollback hooks.

marta: yep — integrate with route rollouts API and our canary token split. also emit events for every suggestion apply/rollback for audit.

sam: sounds good. final ask: telemetry should record why suggestion existed (rule eval trace). we need reproducibility for postmortems.

marta: agreed — store trace snippets and the scoring inputs. small PII-safe snapshot only.

jordan: ok if design/PM want it, i can prototype a compact panel: 1) suggestion list 2) sample impact 3) provenance 4) apply button with mode.

marta: amazing. thanks. any objections to me opening an RFC and a small spike ticket? :raised_hands:
